Ana (PM): Quick sync — targeting Quantization GA next sprint. Need signoff on SLA, docs, pricing, monitoring, and support runbook. Can owners confirm?
Mike (Eng): Ran perf sweep: p50/p90/p99 for int8 and int4 at seq_len=512. p99: int8 ~= 210ms, int4 ~= 240ms. Recommend GA SLO p99 <= 250ms and opt-in feature flag for int4.
Ravi (ML): Accuracy notes: int8 median drop ~0.1%, int4 ~0.7% on our eval set. Recommend a quality-monitor gate and a sampled eval against gold before rollout phases.
Sara (Docs): I'll own public GA docs, migration guide, changelog. Need canonical list of known regressions and mitigation tips. ETA: Wed EOD for draft PR.
James (Sales): Enterprise asks: explicit SLA credit language and a rollback/escape window (30 days) for customers switching to quantized models. Will need Legal signoff. Pricing proposal: int8 = -15% token price, int4 = -30%.
Emily (Support): Need KB + support training. Runbook should include how to detect "bad decode", rollback steps, and escalations. Who will draft operational runbook?
Ana (PM): Owners: Mike+Ravi runbook + fallback behavior; Sara docs + external KB; Emily support training + playbook; James commercial language + legal loop.
Mike (Eng): Technical flag: cold-start fallback causes p99 spikes on KV cache misses. Proposed canary config for staged rollout: ```{ "canary": true, "traffic_split": {"canary":0.05,"stable":0.95}, "max_p99_latency_ms":300, "fallback":"route-to-stable-on-violation", "monitoring": ["p50","p90","p99","error_rate","quality_drift"] }```
Ravi (ML): Add daily sampled eval job comparing prod responses to gold. If accuracy drift > 1% trigger automated rollback. Emit quantization tag in telemetry to segment metrics by model variant.
deploy-bot: Canary launched on quantize-canary at 5201234590 — 5% traffic.
Sara (Docs): Docs checklist: migration guide, changelog, pricing FAQ, SLA appendix, known regressions + mitigations, KB 'reverting quantized models'. I'll open PR and link here.
James (Sales): I'll draft the commercial language and ping Legal. Need SLA credit language template and rollback wording.
Emily (Support): Scheduling 45m training Tue; will draft runbook once Mike/Ravi share fallback playbook.
Ana (PM): Decision deadline EOD Friday (5201234680). If no objections we graduate to 20% Monday. GA SLO candidate fixed: p99 <= 250ms. SLA credits pending Legal.
Mike (Eng): +1
